mapper.select: SELECT id, title, description, status, category, display_order AS displayOrder, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tasks ORDER BY display_order ASC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (title, description, status, category, display_order) VALUES ( #{title}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'TODO'), #{category}, COALESCE(#{displayOrder}, 0) )
